works.altpicture: Landing Page Mie Ayam Pak De Vespa
works.title: Landing Page Mie Ayam Pak De Vespa
works.paragraph: A profile website and landing page for the culinary business Mie Ayam Pak De Vespa in Pekanbaru. It features signature menus, operational schedules, Google Maps location, and direct WhatsApp contact for customer orders. Built using Antigravity (Agentic Coding), Tailwind, and Semantic HTML.

works.title: BicaraAja.AI
works.paragraph: A web application that helps high school students and corporate professionals compose the right communication statements for conversational partners across different social hierarchies (teachers, school principals, managers, or colleagues) with a privacy-first, login-free experience. Built using Kiro (specs coding), Gemini AI (Ai Engine), and Next JS.

works.title: Tabel Siswa SMA
works.paragraph: The website is the result of my learning about react-redux with CRUD table (Create, Read, Update, and Delete). This website use mui-material (react component library) and Axios & Fetch to get API from dummyjson.com.
